players.product: copper-clad laminates with in-house electronic fibreglass yarn / fabric (incl. low-Dk, low-CTE and quartz specialty yarn) and RTF / HVLP copper foil for high-frequency, high-speed AI boards

quarterly_data.quarter: Kingboard Laminates interim results announcement: 2026 Interim Results (08-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 (six months ended 30 June): revenue HK$14,903.8 million, +55% year on year; EBITDA HK$4,130.3 million, +143%; net profit attributable to owners HK$2,886.6 million, +209%. The Laminates Division's revenue rose 56% to HK$14,774.8 million and its EBITDA 170% to HK$4,336.3 million, attributed to a notable rise in product unit prices plus efficiency gains and automation.
quarterly_data.figure: revenue HK$14,903.8 million (+55%); net profit HK$2,886.6 million (+209%); Laminates Division revenue HK$14,774.8 million (+56%), EBITDA HK$4,336.3 million (+170%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Kingboard Laminates interim results announcement: 2026 Interim Results (08-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Laminates and their upstream materials (electronic fibreglass yarn and fabric, copper foil) remained in tight supply in H1 2026; the Group's products saw multiple price increases, accelerating in Q2. A shortage of electronic fibreglass fabric forced some laminate producers to partially suspend production, while the vertically integrated Group kept near-full-capacity production; laminate shipment volume rose 14% year on year with monthly average shipments above 10 million sheets. Demand for thick copper foil for AI and for high-frequency, high-speed, low-signal-loss RTF and HVLP copper foil grew significantly, causing an overall copper foil shortage and notably higher unit prices.
quarterly_data.figure: laminate shipments +14% YoY; monthly average shipments exceeding 10 million sheets

quarterly_data.quarter: Kingboard Laminates interim results announcement: 2026 Interim Results (08-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The Group commissioned 4 newly built kilns for specialty electronic fibreglass yarn (5 in total), strengthening its share in new AI materials for high-frequency, high-speed and high-end IC packaging substrates; existing capacity has largely shifted to AI-related products, causing severe shortages of traditional yarn and fabric. The electronic fibreglass yarn and fabric business earned a profit of approximately HK$1 billion in H1 2026, up approximately 280% year on year.
quarterly_data.figure: yarn and fabric business profit approximately HK$1 billion (+approximately 280%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Kingboard Laminates interim results announcement: 2026 Interim Results (08-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Prospects (company): since the start of H2 2026 the electronic fibreglass fabric shortage has intensified further and prices of laminates, yarn, fabric and copper foil have continued to surge; profit for July 2026 was approximately HK$1.1 billion, a new monthly high. Management expects the laminate supply-demand imbalance is unlikely to ease in the near term and the industry to remain in an upward cycle of robust demand and constrained supply.

quarterly_data.quarter: Kingboard Laminates interim results announcement: 2026 Interim Results (08-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capacity plan: the 70,000-tonne/year electronic fibreglass yarn project in Shaoguan was commissioned ahead of schedule at end-June 2026; eight specialty yarn kilns are under construction in Qingyuan (first- and second-generation low-Dk, low-CTE and quartz yarn), two to be commissioned in H2 2026, taking specialty kilns to 13; Lianzhou ultra-fine yarn Phase II (10,000 tonnes/year) is targeted for Q1 2027. Fabric: Shaoguan 95 million metres/year fully commissioned in Q3 2026, Nansha 150 million metres/year targeted for Q3 2027, Qingyuan 78 million metres/year mainly specialty fabric for AI in H1 2027; weaving looms to rise from 3,333 in 2025 to 5,833 by 2028, lifting fabric capacity to 1.05 billion metres including 100 million metres of specialty fabric. Copper foil: a 21,000-tonne RTF/HVLP project is planned in Qingyuan for Q3 2027. Laminates: Pingxiang project of 1.1 million sheets and 20,000 rolls of prepreg per month, Phase I (350,000 sheets) in mid-2027. About HK$1.8 billion was invested in new capacity in H1 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: specialty yarn kilns to 13; looms 3,333 to 5,833 by 2028; fabric capacity 1.05 billion metres incl. 100 million metres specialty; RTF/HVLP copper foil 21,000 tonnes (Q3 2027); approximately HK$1.8 billion capacity investment in H1 2026

Kingboard Laminates.why: Copper-clad laminate maker vertically integrated into electronic fibreglass yarn/fabric and copper foil; sells laminate and specialty AI materials (low-Dk / low-CTE yarn, RTF/HVLP foil) into high-speed server boards, so AI server builds drive its volumes and prices.
